notes: Anchor check passed: median GMAT Focus 685, median Classic 730, median GRE 164 Quant and 164 Verbal confirmed for Class of 2027. US News 2026 rank is a tie at No. 4 with Northwestern Kellogg. GPA and work experience were not seen in authoritative snippets and are nulled. Acceptance rate is P&Q's estimate for the 2025-26 cycle; US News 2026 separately reported 11.2%. HBS does not publish an acceptance rate on its class profile; the existing figure in the library is a P and Q estimate. Median base salary: HBS publishes it only in the recruiting employment-data section, which is JavaScript rendered and sits behind an AWS WAF challenge; both WebFetch and curl returned empty shells or challenge pages, so the official salary figure could not be read this session and the existing P and Q sourced value was left untouched. The employment rate definition is offers received, not accepted; the blog gives no accepted-offer percentage. Tuition replaces the prior fiscal 2025 annual report figure with the official 2026-27 cost of attendance rate.
